nodes.speaker: ops
nodes.text: The ship is nearly at its weight limit. There's room for one big crate: extra food or spare parts?
nodes.fact: Most of a rocket's liftoff weight is fuel, so engineers count every kilogram of cargo.

nodes.speaker: sci
nodes.text: Dr. Okafor has one more rack of science instruments. Squeeze it in?

variants.text: The food crate is in. Dr. Okafor begs for room for a rack of science instruments too.
The spares crate is in. Dr. Okafor wants room for a rack of science instruments too.

fact.moon: Moon missions carry instruments that study dust, rocks and radiation, which helps keep future crews safe.
fact.mars: Mars rover Perseverance carries MOXIE, a toaster-sized machine that made oxygen from Mars's carbon dioxide air.
